 The Rutgers Scarlet Knights play the UNLV Rebels at Michelob ULTRA Arena in Las Vegas, Nevada. Thursday's meeting is the first of the season between the two squads. Rutgers is 3-0 at home, and UNLV is 0-0 on the road.
